name: main-red-ci-log
about: Main goes red after a merge and the runner files the P1 (#2). When it claims #2 for triage it fetches the failed run's log (gh run view --log-failed), cuts it to the failing test, strips colour codes and the token-like string in it, attaches it as ci-failure.log ('CI failure on <sha>: test') and points the triage brief at it, with the race hint. Build of #2 finds it in .loop/triage/.

evidence.name: ci-failure.log
evidence.label: ^CI failure on [0-9a-f]{7}: test$
evidence.text:
(?s)^CI failure on [0-9a-f]{7}: test

==== job: test ====
.*--- FAIL: TestDigest \(0\.02s\)
    digest_test\.go:12: got "old wording", want "new wording" \(GH_TOKEN=\[redacted\]\)
